book.name: Mɑɑku
book.title: LABAARI GEA NGE MƐ MAAKU U YORUA

content: Yesu u tɔmbu nɔrɔbun
subɑ nnɛ diisiɑ
Sɑnɑm dɔɔ sɑnɑm wee, tɔn wɔru ɡunɑ yɑ kpɑm mɛnnɑ win mi. N deemɑ bɑ ǹ mɔ ye bɑ koo di. Yerɑ Yesu u win bwɑ̃ɑbu sokɑ u nɛɛ,
tɔn wɔru ɡen wɔnwɔndɑ mɑn mɔ̀ domi yen sɔ̃ɔ itɑ wee mìn di bɑ kɑ mɑn wɑ̃ɑ. Bɑ ǹ mɑɑ ɡɑ̃ɑnu mɔ ni bɑ koo di.
Nɑ̀ n mɑɑ nɛɛ bu wio, bɑ kun ɡɑ̃ɑnu di bɑ koo wɔruku swɑɑ sɔɔ, domi mìn di ben ɡɑbɑ nɑ, n tomɑ.
Mɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbɑ nùn bikiɑ bɑ nɛɛ, mɑnɑ sɑ ko pɛ̃ɛ wɑ ɡbɑbu teni sɔɔ ye yɑ koo tɔn beni debiɑ.
Yesu bu bikiɑ u nɛɛ, pɛ̃ɛ nyewɑ i mɔ. Mɑ bɑ nɛɛ, nɔɔbɑ yiru.
Yerɑ u tɔn wɔru ɡe sɔ̃ɔwɑ ɡu sinɔ temɔ. Mɑ u pɛ̃ɛ nɔɔbɑ yiru ye suɑ, u Gusunɔ siɑrɑ, mɑ u ye mururɑ u win bwɑ̃ɑbu wɛ̃ bu tɔn be yɑbuɑ. Mɑ bɑ ye tɔn wɔru ɡe bɔnu kuɑ.
Bɑ mɑɑ swɛ̃ɛ piiminu ɡɑnu mɔ. Mɑ Yesu u Gusunɔ siɑrɑ nin sɔ̃, mɑ u win bwɑ̃ɑbu sɔ̃ɔwɑ bu mɑɑ ni tɔn be yɑbuo.
Bɑ di bɑ debɑ. Mɑ bwɑ̃ɑbɑ sukum mɛ n tie ɡurɑ mɑ n yibɑ birenu nɔɔbɑ yiru sɔɔ.
Tɔn ben ɡeerɑ turɑ nɡe nɔrɔbun subɑ nnɛ (4.000). Yen biru Yesu u bu yɑrinɑsiɑ.
Mii mii wi kɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbu bɑ ɡoo nimkuu duɑ bɑ dɑ tem ɡɑm ɡiɑ mɛ bɑ rɑ soku Dɑmɑnutɑ.
Fɑlisibɑ bɑ yĩreru bikiɑmɔ
Miyɑ Fɑlisi ɡɑbɑ nɑ Yesun mi, mɑ bɑ kɑ nùn sikirinɔ wɔri. Bɑ nùn bikiɑ u bu sɔ̃ɔsi kɑ yĩreru mɑ win dɑm weewɑ wɔllun di. Bɑ ɡeruɑ mɛ bu kɑ win lɑɑkɑri mɛɛri.
Yerɑ u wom mwɛ mɑ u bu bikiɑ u nɛɛ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ tɛ̃n tɔn beni bɑ yĩreru bikiɑmɔ. Kɑ ɡeemɑ, nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ, yĩreru ɡɑru sɑri te bɑ koo bu sɔ̃ɔsi.
Mɑ u bu deri, u kpɑm ɡoo nimkuu duɑ u kɑ tɔburɑ ɡuru ɡiɔ.
Fɑlisibɑn pɛ̃ɛ seeyɑtiɑ kɑ Heroduɡiɑ
Bwɑ̃ɑ be, bɑ duɑri bu pɛ̃ɛ kusenu ko. Tiɑ tɔnɑwɑ bɑ mɔ ɡoo nimkuu sɔɔ.
Yesu bu yiire u nɛɛ, i bɛɛn tii lɑɑkɑri koowo kpɑ i n Fɑlisibɑn pɛ̃ɛ seeyɑtiɑ ɡeri kɑ mɑɑ Heroduɡiɑ.
Mɑ bɑ ɡerunɑmɔ ben tii tiinɛ sɔɔ bɑ nɛɛ, yèn sɔ̃ bɑ ǹ pɛ̃ɛ mɔ yen sɔ̃nɑ u ɡeruɑ mɛ.
Yesu u tubɑ ye bɑ ɡerunɑmɔ mɑ u nɛɛ, mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ i ɡerumɔ i nɛɛ, yèn sɔ̃ i ǹ pɛ̃ɛ mɔ yen sɔ̃nɑ. I ǹ ɡie? N ǹ bɛɛ yeeri ɡinɑ? Bɛɛ swɑɑ tɑobɑ rò?
I ǹ nɔni mɔ rò? I ku rɑ yɑm wɑ? I ǹ swɑsu mɔ? I ku rɑ ɡɑri nɔ? I ǹ yɑɑye
dɔmɑ te nɑ pɛ̃ɛ nɔɔbu mururɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbun subɑ nɔɔbun (5.000) sɔ̃? Birenu nye sɔɔrɑ i ɡure ye bɑ di n tiɑ. Bɑ nùn wisɑ bɑ nɛɛ, wɔkurɑ yiru.
Yesu u kpɑm bu bikiɑ u nɛɛ, ye nɑ pɛ̃ɛ nɔɔbɑ yiru mururɑ tɔmbu nɔrɔbun subɑ nnɛn (4.000) sɔ̃, birenu nye sɔɔrɑ i ɡure ye bɑ di n tiɑ. Bɑ nɛɛ, nɔɔbɑ yiru.
Mɑ u nɛɛ, n ǹ bɛɛ yeeri kɑ tɛ̃?
Yesu u wɔ̃ko bɛkiɑ Bɛsɑidɑɔ
Sɑnɑm mɛ bɑ turɑ wuu ɡe bɑ rɑ soku Bɛsɑidɑɔ, tɔmbu ɡɑbɑ kɑ wɔ̃ko ɡoo nɑ Yesun mi mɑ bɑ nùn kɑnɑ u nùn bɑbɑ.
U wɔ̃ko win nɔmɑ nɛnuɑ u kɑ dɑ wuun biruɔ. Yen biru u yɑ̃ɑtɑm sie win nɔniɔ mɑ u yi nɔmɑ sɔndi u nɛɛ, ɑ ɡɑ̃ɑnu wɑɑmɔ?
Durɔ wi, u nɔni wukiɑ u nɛɛ, nɑ tɔmbu wɑɑmɔ. Bɑ kɑ dɑ̃nu weenɛ bɑ sĩimɔ.
Mɑ Yesu kpɑm win nɔmɑ sɔndi wɔ̃ko win nɔni wɔllɔ. Ye u yɑ̃ɑtem nɔni ɡirɑri, u bɛkurɑ mɑ u kpuro wɑɑmɔ sɑ̃ɑ sɑ̃ɑ.
Yesu nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u wio, u ku mɑɑ wurɑ wuu nukurɔ.
Piɛɛ nɛɛ Yesu u sɑ̃ɑwɑ wi Gusunɔ u ɡɔsɑ
Sɑnɑm mɛyɑ Yesu u doonɑ kɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbu Sesɑreɔ, Filipin tem ɡiɑ. Mɑ swɑɑ sɔɔ u win bwɑ̃ɑbu bikiɑ u nɛɛ, nɑ nɛɛ yɑ? Wɑrɑ tɔmbɑ ɡerumɔ nɑ sɑ̃ɑ.
Bɑ nɛɛ, ɡɑbɑ ɡerumɔ Yohɑnu Bɑtɛmu kowowɑ, ɡɑbɑ mɑɑ ɡerumɔ Eliwɑ, mɑ ɡɑbɑ kpɑm ɡerumɔ ɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ Gusunɔn sɔmɔbun turo.
Mɑ u bu bikiɑ u nɛɛ, to, bɛɛ mɑɑ ni, ɑmɔnɑ bɛɛn tii i ɡerumɔ. Piɛɛ nùn wisɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ Kirisi wi.
Yerɑ Yesu u bu ɡerusi u nɛɛ, bu ku rɑɑ ye ɡoo sɔ̃.
Yesu u win ɡɔɔ kɑ win seebun ɡɑri mɔ̀

Mɑ u bwɑ̃ɑ be sɔ̃ɔbu wɔri u nɛɛ, Tɔnun Bii u ǹ koo ko u kun nɔni swɑ̃ɑ bɑkɑru wɑ kpɑ ɡuro ɡurobu kɑ yɑ̃ku kowo tɔnwerobu kɑ woodɑ yɛ̃robu bu nùn yinɑ kpɑ bu nùn ɡo, ɑdɑmɑ u koo se ɡɔrin di sɔ̃ɔ itɑse.
U ɡɑri yi ɡeruɑwɑ kpɑsɑsɑ. Yerɑ Piɛɛ kɑ nùn dɑ bɔkuɔ mɑ u nùn ɡerusibu wɔri.
Adɑmɑ Yesu sĩirɑ u win bwɑ̃ɑbu mɛɛrɑ mɑ u Piɛɛ ɡerusi u nɛɛ, ɑ dɛsiro nɛn birun di Setɑm, domi wunɛn bwisikunu kun sɑ̃ɑ Gusunɔɡinu, nu sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔnuɡinu.
Yen biru Yesu u tɔn wɔru sokɑ kɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbu sɑnnu, mɑ u nɛɛ, ɡoo ù n kĩ u nɛn yirɑ swĩi nɡe bɔ̃̀ɔ, u win ɡɔ̃ru kĩru derio kpɑ u win tiin dɑ̃ɑ bunɑnɑru suɑ kpɑ u mɑn swĩi.
Domi bɑɑwure wi u kĩ u win wɑ̃ɑru di kɑ win ɡɔ̃ru kĩru, u koo tu biɑ. Adɑmɑ bɑɑwure wi u win wɑ̃ɑru yinɑ nɛn sɔ̃ kɑ nɛn Lɑbɑɑri ɡeɑn sɔ̃, wiyɑ u koo tu wɑ kɑ ɡem.
Arufɑɑni yerɑ̀ tɔnu u mɔ, bɑɑ ù n hɑnduniɑn ɡɑ̃ɑnu kpuro wɑ, mɑ u win wɑ̃ɑru biɑ.
Mbɑ tɔnu u koo kɑ win wɑ̃ɑru kɔsinɑ.

Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, bɑɑwure wi u nɛn sekuru mɔ̀ kɑ mɑɑ nɛn ɡɑri tɛ̃n tɔn kɔ̃sobun suunu sɔɔ, be bɑ ǹ kɑ Gusunɔ turo yɔ̃, Tɔnun Bii u koo win sekuru ko ù n wurɑmɑ win Bɑɑbɑn yiiko sɔɔ kɑ Gusunɔn ɡɔrɑdo dɛɛrobu sɑnnu.
